findings.title: No structured data on this page
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides has no JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa. Structured data is how AI assistants reliably extract who/what/when about your content. Add at least Organization (site-wide) and Article/Product (per page).

findings.title: No publish or update date detected
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides/what-is-fleet-leasing-and-how-does-it-work has no detectable publication or modification date. Recency is a citation signal for AI assistants. Add a JSON-LD datePublished/dateModified or a <time datetime="..."> element.

findings.title: Only 41% of images have alt text
findings.message: 19 out of 32 images on https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides are missing alt text. AI assistants use alt to understand images. Add descriptive alt attributes. (Plus 5 more pages with a milder version of this issue, counted proportionally in the score.)

findings.title: No identity schema (Organization or Person) on the home page
findings.message: Your home page has no Organization, Person, or LocalBusiness JSON-LD. AI assistants use these to know who you are. Pick whichever fits: a company -> Organization, a personal site -> Person, a venue with an address -> LocalBusiness.

findings.title: Q&A content not marked up as FAQ schema
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides/top-10-electric-lease-cars-2025 has 3 headings written as questions but no FAQPage JSON-LD. Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in 2023, so this no longer helps SERP appearance, but AI assistants still use the structured Q&A pairs when extracting answers. Optional but cheap, and only worth doing if these really are question/answer pairs.

findings.title: Headings that may be questions (not scored)
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides/diesel-engine-additives has 1 heading that reads like a question ("How...", "What...", "Why...") but is not written as a question (no "?"), with little text beneath. We could not confirm it is genuine Q&A, so we did not score it. If it is a question your audience actually asks, phrase the heading as a question and add a self-contained 115-180 word answer directly beneath it, so AI assistants can quote it without surrounding context.

findings.title: No question-shaped headings
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/faqs has no headings phrased as questions ("How does...", "Why is..."). AI assistants extract Q&A pairs from such headings. Rephrase 1-2 h2/h3 headings as questions when appropriate.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips levels
findings.message: https://selectcarleasing.co.uk jumps heading levels (e.g. h2 directly to h4). A clean h1 -> h2 -> h3 hierarchy helps AI assistants understand structure.

findings.title: Outbound links present, authority not verified
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/faqs links out to 7 external domains, but none are on our recognised high-authority list (which is deliberately partial). Sanity-check that the sources you cite are credible.

findings.title: Page body is moderate
findings.message: https://www.selectcarleasing.co.uk/guides has 771 visible words. Solid, but the most-cited pages tend to run 1000+ words of focused content. Optional polish.
